QuestInfo.name: Killing Time
QuestInfo.2: Lolo gave you a scroll with the Aurora emblem when you got back from slaughtering Royal Fairies.
QuestInfo.0: Lolo isn't completely spineless, after all! He has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: Practice your Light and Dark powers by obliterating #b20 Royal Fairies#k while Lolo looks for some record of Aurora.
